Warletter_text1_rsc.value:
Dear %s,
  I hope this letter finds you well.  Given the times, one must keep their own security in mind.  As you know, these are troubling times, indeed.
  I have written you to get your opinion of the recent murder.  Such a henious act will undoubtedly be punished swiftly.  Of course, I am very interested in aiding the investigation; I am sure this issue is of utmost importance to you as well.  Perhaps we can help each other in this investigation.
  As of late, I have reason to mistrust Maleval and his motives.  His interests in both the former Duke and the Priestess of Qor are important in my mind.  I wonder if the dark mage is part of some dark plot.
  I have also heard rumors that a certain outcast is stirring trouble with the common folk, particularly around Jasper.  Such a character has never had much concern for the decent folk in our land, and may have some hidden ambition that we should watch.
  Please respond if you have any information.  As I mentioned, the murder must be punished swiftly and efficiently.  Together, I am certain we will be able to bring justice to the fallen Duke.

Sincerely,
%s

Warletter_text2_rsc.value:
%s,
  I respond to your last letter out of courtesy.  Such remarks do nothing to enhance yourself or to your point of view in my eyes.
  First, one should not defend the acts of a murderer.  I know you will deny this accusation, but the tone of your previous correspondence leaves no doubt that you hold this person in high regard.  Although certain members of our society see nothing wrong with murder to accomplish their tasks, I believe the more visible members of our society should be above that.
  Furthermore, I cannot agree with your support of any talks of rebellion.  I believe that any dissention should be quelled as soon as it is mentioned!  Perhaps I talked of such things when I was younger and more foolish, but I have seen the truth of that matter.  Talk of rebellion only causes more problems and more suffering.  The commoners are already well cared for; should we allow another to inflict more suffering on the people that are content with their lives?
  I hope my letter has opened your eyes and that you keep yourself from falling into dangerous traps of logic.  The murderer should be brought to justice, and any talk of rebellion need to be banished.  Our lands must be united in peace, not divided in war.

%s

Warletter_text3_rsc.value:
Dearest %s,
  If I did not know you as well as I do, I would worry that you are suggesting I had some hand in the diabolical plot that is on everyone's mind currently.  However, I am certain that this is not the case.
  As I have told you before, I do not know who plotted against the Duke.  I have heard some interesting rumors that perhaps it was not one person that murdered in cold blood, but rather several people plotting together.  People have said that too much seemingly plausible information is spreading through the lands to be restricted to just one person.
  I do not know what to think.  The roving troops of both factions frighten me, and I often find myself wishing for the more calm and peaceful days of recent memory.
  I hope you are doing well.  Keep yourself safe from harm.  I hope to see you soon.

Your friend,
%s

Warletter_text4_rsc.value:
%s,
  Do not send me correspondence of that type ever again through such public channels.  We must make sure we use people we trust in order to communicate our ideas.
  Keep this in mind.  Hail to the Third!

%s

Warletter_text5_rsc.value:
Dear %s,
  I could not agree more with your last letter.  It was almost as if you were reading my mind as you penned it.
  Who else but the nephew could have known so much and could have reaped such a huge benefit from the murder?  No one, I say.  I realize you were merely speculating on the limited information we had, but if you think about the whole scenario logically, only one answer remains in any sane person's mind.  Only someone like Ran er'Hoth could believe otherwise.
  Well, I must attend to other matters.  I will send this letter via a courier as soon as I can locate one.  I await your quick response.

Sincerely,
%s

Warletter_text6_rsc.value:
%s,
  Please do not write me again, as your irrational and oppressive views of rebellion cannot be tolerated in our current environment.  If you are so blind as to not see how your ideas will only hurt the people living near the Meridian, then you are more insane than I thought possible.

%s

Warletter_text7_rsc.value:
My friend, dear %s
  Allow me to apologize for my last letter.  I truly cannot say what madness took over my thoughts and prevented me from thinking rationally.  All I can say is that your response set my thinking straight.
  I wish all my friends were as level-headed as you are.  I fear that perhaps the idle chatter of some of my other acquaintances influenced my thinking for the worse.  I should be more mindful of the company I keep.
  I will take measures to guard against this type of thought in the future.

Again, my deepest apologies,
%s

Warletter_text8_rsc.value:
Dear %s,
  Perhaps rebellion is the answer.  I loathe to think of the suffering it might cause, but sometimes it is better to stand up for a principle we believe in rather than allow the other horrible events.  I am sure these words may brand me as a malcontent, but I feel in my heart that this is the thinking we must do in order to save our fair lands.
  Does the nobility really care for the common folk anymore?  I fear they are too wrapped up in their games of the court to see how many people suffer.  The people of Jasper have been living in a depressed town for a long time now without so much as even a kind word.  Not to speak ill of the departed, but I think the only reason the former Duke cared for the place is because he owned the bank.  I fear that less rational minds than yours and mine in this town may take the idea of rebellion to a frightening conclusion.
  Not only do the towns suffer, but even our thriving population of adventurers is preyed upon by the greedy and selfish.  Have either of the leaders, the fair Princess, the former Duke, or even the Councilmembers ever moved to stop this?  No, they have not.  I fear that the adventurers may also take it upon themselves to correct past and current problems.  Obviously, these will be the best place from which to gather fighters for any military offensive.
  I am deeply worried about our lands.  May Kraanan the Fist grant us the strength do do what is best.

%s

Warletter_text9_rsc.value:
To %s, my trusted friend,
  People say I'm being paranoid, but I am beginning to fear for my safety.  People always seem to be walking past me, giving me odd stares and seemingly ready to spring upon me for no good reason!
  Perhaps it is the current atmosphere, but I worry about every armed adventurer that walks past me.  Some of us don't have their ability to fight against the underworld.  Although the spirits protect us, the death of the late Duke prove even they can fail against the blade of a ruthless killer.
  What now?  Do I live my life in fear of unscrupulous people?  Perhaps it isn't even one of the adventurers that did the foul deed.  Perhaps it is one of the disenchanted nobles.  I've never trusted some of them.  I'll be wary of them from now on.
  Or, perhaps it is the evil Lich Queen and her dark Necromancers that have done this dark act in order to bring more chaos to our land.  Ever since that ancient evil came to life, I have feared for my safety.  I should be cautious, those minions are everywhere.  When will the Hunters do their duty to eliminate this menace from our midst?  I should end my letter now, before the murder's blade comes down upon my head.  This letter will be sent via the next adventurer that doesn't have a bloodlust in his or her eyes.  Unfortunately, that type seems to be few and far in between.

Yours in the gods,
%s

Warletter_text10_rsc.value:
%s,
  Although it is a bit frightening, I find the current atmosphere to be a bit exciting.  The death of the Duke, while unfortunate, has stirred up all sorts of conversation about justice and rebellion.  Some people are very excited about finding the killer and bringing him or her to justice.
  The rise of the Duke's nephew also has people questioning the true value of the nobility.  I find this sort of talk a refreshing change of pace.  I hope people will begin to question the world around them and to bring some change.
  We should be wary, though, that the people wanting change don't agitate people too much.  Some change is good, but bloody, violent change helps none but the truly evil.  Not that there's anything wrong with a bit of evil, mind you.
  I await your return letter.  Unfortunately, I cannot include my chess move with this letter.  Your last move was truly diabolical, and I am still in the middle of planning my countermove.  Perhaps I will find another courier to carry the move to you verbally.

Yours in the name of the five gods,
%s

Warletter_text12_rsc.value:
To %s,
  You would not believe the stir that a few well-placed words can create.  It seems that some people are looking for any reason to act violently.  I don't know whether this is a good or bad thing given our current state of affairs.
  I've heard that there are other agitators in the area as well.  I do not know what to make of them.  Perhaps they will support the cause?  In any case, I think we should be waiting and watching as things develop.
  Well, other than that, my life has been pretty mundane.  I have taken to long walks in the countryside contemplating the future of the Meridian.  Luckily, I have been able to dodge most of the monsters in the area.  It seems that there are many adventurers out these days slaying monsters.
  Is our society to blame for this?  With the rampant killing of monsters, it makes sense in a twisted way that one may turn against his fellow travellers.  it would not surprise me that this is exactly what caused the murder of the Duke.  But, does violence need violence to end the madness?
  Well, I shall not bore you further with my thoughts.  I hope that there are brighter days in the future for us.  Unfortunately, all anyone can see currently is the darkness.

Your friend,
%s

Warletter_text13_rsc.value:
Dear %s,
  Trouble seems to follow you no matter where you go!  After your last letter, some guards where here asking about you.  Of course, I denied all knowledge of your actions.  I guess you can thank me later.
  Well, what have you been up to?  Nothing much new around here.  Some rumors about the dark wizard again.  Other rumors about the Jasperites getting upset over something or the other.  You haven't fallen into that fever, have you?  Seems like every day there's new talk about how the Duke's murder signifies the end of the old nobility.  Why are people so willing to rebel against a society that benefits them so?  Aside from the occasional adventurer killing another, our lives are peaceful and calm.
  I should do something productive today.  Perhaps I'll visit a temple and see a priestess.  I haven't done that in a while.  Write when you can!

Sincerely,
%s

Warletter_text14_rsc.value:
%s,
  How can you possibly suggest than anything short of a rebellion will change the current situation?  Have you seen the Duke and Princess organizing troops like they are mobilizing for war?  Have you seen how they have turned their attention from the people to trying to control the court?  Are you already a blind, crazy old fool?
  You know me; given the bloodshed I have already seen, I am the last person that would advocate more violence.  But, there truly no alternative.  I have searched long and hard for any other answer, and each time I come up with no alternative to a probable insurrection.
  What we need is a strong leader that cares about people more than silly games of the court.  Such a person would lead the land to a new golden age.  Once again, the land of the Meridian would stand proud as it did when we had contact with the central Kingdom long ago.
  Think more on this, and I am sure you will agree that my words are more sane than you first thought.

Yours in mind and spirit,
%s

Warletter_text15_rsc.value:
To %s,
  I couldn't help but laugh as I read your last letter.  You just don't realize what a wonderful opportunity we have with the current situation.
  You have often accompanied me to the inn and talked about how our society needs to change.  We have talked long and hard about what events must happen before we can continue to grow as a people.  Were those talks merely idle chatter of an old goat trying to fill the time?
  Yes, the death of the former Duke is unfortunate.  I would not advocate that it was ever a good idea, but it sets the stage for the changes we talked about!  Now we can organize and strike against the society that held as at bay for so long.  Our time has come, and you can only express hesitation!
  What can I say to convince you?  If you cannot see the truth in our past talks, then perhaps I will have to proceed alone.  I cannot allow this opporunity to escape me.  Whether history knows me as a hero or a fool it does not matter.  What will matter is that I know that I did what I thought was right to further the cause of the people of these lands.  Will you not join me?

Yours faithfully,
%s

HunterSword_desc_rsc.value: This weapon is truly a fine piece of workmanship.  Intricate organic carvings intertwine along the hilt, enclosing an exquisitely beautiful gem, almost as if it were an eye gazing calmly back at you.  Indeed, every now and then out of the corner of your eye you almost catch it blinking.

HunterSword_holding_damage.value: As you pick up the Sword of the Hunt, the carven tendrils on the hilt ~Ibite~I your hand!  Taken aback, you fling it to the ground.  That sword does not like you;  you'd best leave it alone.

HunterSword_holding_damage_using.value: The Sword of the Hunt's roots writhe painfully inside your chest with displeasure.  You have done something to invoke the Sword's disapproval!

HunterSword_warning.value: You prepare to pick up the mighty Sword of the Hunt, but it twitches and you hesitate for a moment.  This sword appears to be alive, and it may not allow you to part with it once you have claimed it as your own.  Are you truly prepared for that commitment?

HunterSword_used_rsc.value: You steel your nerve and bravely pick up the Sword of the Hunt.  The hilt immediately comes alive, writhing against the palm of your hand.  You gasp as you feel invisible roots snaking into your chest and wrapping themselves around your heart.  Strangely, you feel no pain throughout this process, only a greatly pleasurable feeling of power and a nagging sense of hunger.

HunterSword_try_unuse_rsc.value: As you try to drop the sword, you feel it tug painfully on the roots that have snaked their way inside your body.  This is not likely to be a productive exercise.

HunterSword_hunger_1.value: Your sword thirsts for the hunt.

HunterSword_hunger_2.value: Your sword is growing impatient for a hunt.

HunterSword_hunger_3.value: Your sword hungers for impure blood.  It is time to hunt.

HunterSword_hunger_4.value: Your sword hungers for impure blood.  Its roots are beginning to draw sustenance from your body to compensate.

HunterSword_hunger_5.value: Your sword hungers for impure blood.  Its roots twitch painfully inside your chest as they suck at your life-essence.

HunterSword_hunger_assuaged.value: Your sword drinks in %s%s's impure blood.  You can feel it course along its roots into your body, filling you with energy.

HunterSword_lose_sword.value: Your unworthiness has offended your sword of the hunt.  Writhing violently in your hands for a few moments, the sword suddenly springs up and away out of sight.

NecromancerGuild_creation_mail.value:
Subject: The Order of Necromancers has been reborn!
I congratulate you on the formation of The Order of Necromancers!  However, there are some rules that you should know about.

MEMBERSHIP:  I leave you to determine the details of the Order's membership, but if the Order does not have at least 3 members in it, I will not be able to maintain my grasp on this plane.  Thus, your first priority now should be to recruit more necromancers to the Order.

INVITING NEW MEMBERS:  When you invite a potential member into the fold, an invitation object is created in their inventory, which they may then choose to accept or ignore.  An invitation will always be created, even if someone may not join the Order for some reason.  A necromancer must be of reasonably high power before he may join the Order, and may not be a member of a mortal guild at the same time.

RANKS:  You may promote people to different ranks, thus giving them more power as well as more responsibility.  You may also keep necromancers at low ranks if you do not feel prepared to trust them.  These are the ranks:
  +++ %s:  have no special abilities, other than to vote for the leader of their choice.  They may not even open the doors to my inner sanctum.
  +++ %s:  only have the ability to vote.
  +++ %s:  have the ability to vote and invite new members into the guild.
  +++ %s:  may vote, invite new members in, kick unruly members out, promote or demote people of lower ranks than themselves, and form or shatter alliances.
  +++ %s:  has all powers associated with the Order.

TRIBUTE:  My continued presence on this plane of reality requires that the Order provide me with a steady flow of life essence.  My hunger grows at a regular rate, and the rate of increase is affected by many factors, including the number of members in your guild and the number of enemies and allies you have declared.  Remember, much of your power originates from me - should you let me go hungry, the members of the Order will all suffer greatly!

Anyone in the Order may supply me with a portion of the life essence they have stored in their own bodies, by simply approaching me and saying that they wish to pay tribute.  However, to avoid confusion, it is recommended that you assign one person to decide whose turn it is to slake my thirst.  To find out how urgent is my hunger, simply ask me.

  -- Venya'cyr, Eternal Queen of Brax

NecromancerGuild_creation2_mail.value:
Subject: Defend my fortress well!
MY FORTRESS:  My fortress is now yours to inhabit and call your home.  Though much of it was destroyed when Brax was swallowed by the earth, some of my magicks have remained intact.  You may rest here in relative safety from the outside world, and will heal from being close to my center of power.  The newsglobe here allows members of the Order to keep each other apprised of current news, and there is a secret door outside with a password that you may set (until you choose one, the password is "deathmage").  The door to my inner sanctum can only be opened by necromancers of sufficient rank.
Beware those who wield the Sword of the Hunt, my pet!  This weapon is truly to be feared, and must be guarded well - thanks to the accursed mage Tendrath, it periodically appears here in my fortress.  Luckily, the maze which I constructed to torment my prisoners is still functional, and is the only route to gain access to my inner sanctum or to the chambers where the Sword appears.  There are a number of levers in the secret room beyond the password-protected door which control the configuration of the maze.  Each lever, when pulled, will raise or lower a few sections of the maze's walls.  I also enchanted a number of crystal balls with which you may spy on the maze from a four different vantage points, so that you may be able to spot intruders and thwart their progress through the labyrinth.  You would do well to master the manipulation of the maze, for it is vital that you keep me safe from harm.  Your continued existence is now inextricably intertwined with my own;  should a band of pesky mortals break through to my inner sanctum and destroy my current physical manifestation, all members of the Order shall perish along with me.

Serve me well and my power is yours to share, my dark minion!  Together, we shall sow the seeds of destruction and devour the world!  -- Venya'cyr, Eternal Queen of Brax

guild_creation_mail.value:
Subject: Your guild has been formed
I congratulate you on the formation of %s%q!  However, there are some rules that you should know about.

MATURITY:  I will not allow just any guild to rent a hall.  You must First prove your mettle out in the world.  I will inform you when I feel your guild is mature.  Then (and only then) may you rent a hall or conquer another guild's hall.

MEMBERSHIP:  I leave you to determine the details of your guild's memberships, but if your guild does not have at least 3 members in it, it is not worth my trouble to keep up the paperwork on it, and I will disband the guild.  Thus, your First priority now should be getting your guild up to three members.

INVITING NEW MEMBERS:  When you invite a potential member into the fold, an invitation is created in their inventory, which they may then choose to accept or ignore.  An invitation will always be created, even if someone may not join a guild for some reason.  A player must be of reasonably high power before he may join a guild, and may only be a member of one guild at a time.

RANKS:  You may promote people to different ranks, thus giving them more power as well as more responsibility.  You may also keep players at low ranks if you do not feel prepared to trust them.  These are the ranks:
  +++ %q:  have no special abilities, other than to vote for the leader of their choice.  They may not even open the outer doors of their own guild hall.
  +++ %q:  only have the ability to vote.
  +++ %q:  have the ability to vote and invite new members into the guild.
  +++ %q:  may vote, invite new members in, kick unruly members out, promote or demote people of lower ranks than themselves, and form or shatter alliances.  They may also rent a guild hall if their guild is mature.
  +++ %q:  has all powers associated with guilding, including the right to disband the guild.

RENT:  It costs me time and money to keep up the paperwork involved with your charter, and thus I charge for the service.  Rent is accrued at a regular rate, and the rate of increase is affected by many factors, including the number of members in your guild and the number of enemies and allies you have declared.  The largest affector of rent is whether or not you own a guild hall.  Guild halls can be quite expensive, and so it is recommended that you wait until your guild has several members First.

Incidentally, anyone in your guild can pay me rent owed.  However, to avoid confusion, it is recommended that you assign one person to handle the task of tracking and verifying rent payments by members.

Congratulations on the formation of your guild, and don't forget to pay your rent!

  -- Frular, the Guild Administrator

guild_mature_mail.value:
Subject: Your guild is now mature
%s%q is now a mature guild, meaning that its members may now own and conquer guild halls.

GUILD HALLS:  A guild may lay claim to a guild hall by purchasing a lease from myself.  Guild halls offer their owners a handful of perks, including a reasonably safe place to rest, a newsglobe for guild news, a secret door guarded by a password that you set.  Guild halls are also sanctuaries, where a player heals faster.

Guild halls are guarded by an outer door with a mystic defense shield.  Only members of the owner guild may open a guild's outer door.  However, once the door is open, anyone may enter.  The door stays open for a very limited period of time.

CONQUEST:  Each guild hall also has a mystic shield deactivator.  If this deactivator is used, then the guild hall's defenses go down, and anyone may open the hall's outer doors.  If the deactivator ever stays down for ten minutes at a time, the guild hall is declared 'conquered'.

Only the guild that conquered a specific guild hall may rent it afterwards.  However, you may only own one guild hall at a time, meaning that the conquering guild must abandon their current hall to get the new one.  After a period of one hour after being conquered, the guild hall re-enters the open market, and anyone may rent it.

BETRAYAL AND MERCENARY CONQUEST:  If a guild hall is conquered by a member of your own guild, then the guild is officially embarrassed.  At that point, anyone other than the conquered guild may rent the hall.  This limit lasts one hour.

ALLIES:  If you declare a guild to be an ally, then they may enter your guild hall as if it were their own.  This measure of trust also lowers your guild's rent.

ENEMIES:  If you declare a guild to be an enemy, then you will obtain very immediate and detailed warning if they attempt to conquer your guild.  Otherwise, you will get very fuzzy and somewhat delayed information from your guild's mystic defenses.  Also, if two guilds mutually declare war on each other, they enter a state of war as I will describe in a moment.  This additional security and recognition comes at the cost of additional rent.

WAR:  If you and declare a guild to be an enemy and that guild likewise declares your guild as an enemy, you enter a state of war.  This war is recognized by all the powers in Meridian; during such a mutually declared war, either guild may attack the other without fear of punishment from either the gods, the Justicar, or any lieges.  Note that leaving a state of war is not immediate or without cost.  You must wait a full Meridian day during which you must sue for peace from the enemy guild yet can still be attacked under the rules of war.  Should a guild sue for peace in a mutually declared war, I shall deduct part of that guild's rent and give a share to the victorious guild.  But, if an enemy sues for peace you must wait a day before you can undeclare them as enemies, otherwise I will assume you wish to end hostilities early, and both guilds will be penalized.  After the delay, your status as non-enemies will be officially noted.  Please note that you must have a considerable sum of rent prepaid to even declare a guild an enemy in the First place.  This is to cover the costs should that guild return the declaration and initiate a war.

LOW RANKS:  Anyone of rank '%q' may not open the outer doors of your guild hall, regardless of if they are in your own guild or in an ally's guild.

Congratulations on your guild's coming of age.  I know you'll go far.

  -- Frular, the Guild Administrator

ModelNode_desc_rsc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Found at various places around Meridian, these gatherings of mystic energy provide strength to spellcasters who can meld with them.  The origin of these nodes is a mystery even to the most devoted scholars, such as Councillor Esseldi.  Some mages believe that they have something to do with the Nexus which inexplicably shattered hundreds of years ago, severing contact from Meridian59 to the other worlds of the Nexus.  The mana nodes of Meridian may, therefore, be remnants of that cataclysmic magical upheaval, though none can say for certain.

oo_3bolts_desc.value: These three bolts are used for the common clothes of Ko'catan.

oo_apple4_desc.value: These sand apples are especially good for pickling.  After they soak in a salty brine for eight months, their bitter taste provides a perfect compliment to sweet wine.

oo_bagbean4_desc.value: Dried Kuto beans completely fill this hemp bag.

oo_basket4_desc.value: Grapes native to the island are too tangy for most as food, but make for excellent wine.

oo_bigbag4_desc.value: Browncorn is the staple food of the Ko'catani people.

oo_birdbx4_desc.value: This is a captive Zi zi yijoa, a friendly pet and sometimes food item.

oo_blubott4_desc.value: Within this blue bottle is a magical concoction taken by most merchants before initiating a transaction.  This liquid is not meant to be ingested, only rolled over the tongue until its strong mint flavor is too much to endure.

oo_bolt1_desc.value: Made from the tiny beach worm, this silk is colored from the crushed up shells of Hopit crab.

oo_bolt2_desc.value: Robes made from this silk will keep the wearer cool on the hottest day, yet provides sufficient insulation for windy nights.

oo_bolt4_desc.value: Primarily used for capes, the kawil dye for this luxurious fabric can only be extracted during the winter months when the Temda root is molting.

oo_bolt5_desc.value: Lined with the fur or the rare jungle ermine, this fabric is used almost exclusively for the spiritualists of the Settlement.

oo_bolt6_desc.value: This fabric contains real gold threads.  Wearing clothes made of this fabric is restricted to one day a year, the birthday of the Tezcha.

oo_boxsnak4_desc.value: These snake carcasses have been split and dried.  The revolting smell indicates that the poison has been drained, or at least that's what you've heard.

oo_brnurn4_desc.value: This clay pot holds a mound of ground Umacha beans.

oo_decopot4_desc.value: Various types of seeds and beans fill this clay pot.

oo_dress3_desc.value: Tepal's master project, a very expensive robe for a high-ranking military official.  Made to be a replica of Konima's legendary war robe.

oo_dress4_desc.value: Nearly complete, this outfit is designed for a rich merchant of the settlement.

oo_fixins4_desc.value: Eggs from the Nahzotz, a domesticated lizard.

oo_flower_desc.value: Travelers are warned not to drink the honey sweet water that this plant stores after a downpour.  Ingesting the nectar produces a condition the locals call "Tezchot", which is quite unpleasant.

oo_flower4_desc.value: Lecumec drying out to eventually be used to as herbs for medicine.

oo_garlic4_desc.value: Cloves of garlic hang from the ceiling to ward away the evil spirits.

oo_goldbot4_desc.value: An aromatic mixture useful in several potions, not because of its mystical properties, but because it masks the smell.

oo_herbs4_desc.value: Once fully dried, these aromatic herbs will make fine pipe stuffing.

oo_jar4_desc.value: You are not sure if you want to know what is floating around in this murky jar.

oo_jbook_desc.value: The pages of this ancient book are yellowed with age, almost rendering the thin, wispy script illegible.  Unfortunately, the book appears to be written in a language which probably predates the severing of the Nexus, as it bears little resemblance to modern writing.

oo_jug4_desc.value: This urn is used to store drinking water.

oo_palm_desc.value: This small palm requires a moderate amount of water to cultivate.  Sharp spines extend from the crown of the plant.

oo_poison4_desc.value: After using a knife to carve through the thick outer husk, the sweet fruit inside is delicious.

oo_pot4_desc.value: This small container holds dried fruit.

oo_potion4_desc.value: Used for fermenting potions and enchanted mixtures.

oo_rock_desc.value: This firmly fused rock would take an army to shove aside.

oo_rock1_desc.value: Protruding from the ocean, this great rock is the home to many sea birds.

oo_rock2_desc.value: Swimming to these rocks would be extremely dangerous.

oo_spices4_desc.value: This shallow basket holds some of the most used spices in Ko'catanese cuisine.

oo_stac1_desc.value: This mighty stalagmite rises up from the floor.

oo_stac2_desc.value: A calcium carbonate deposit formed on the floor of a cave by the dripping of percolating calcareous water.

oo_stag1_desc.value: This impressive stalactite grips the ceiling tightly.

oo_stag2_desc.value: A calcium carbonate deposit, shaped like an icicle, hanging from the roof of the cave.

oo_sticks4_desc.value: Temda Root is boiled to extract kawil dye.  Some say that chewing the raw sticks provides relief from bowel pains, eruptions, reduces redness, swelling, dryness and painful itching.

oo_stoolko_desc.value: An excellent seat for getting those hems right.

oo_tree1_desc.value: This tree is being slowly suffocated by a parasitic tingi vine colony.

oo_tree2_desc.value: This is a mature kichan tree, its leaves interlacing the canopy far above your head.

oo_urn4_desc.value: This urn is overflowing with Achalot nuts, a common seasoning and popular snack.

oo_anvil_desc.value: This well worn iron anvil is lavishly decorated with magic runes.

oo_quiver_desc.value: Handmade by Hanla awaiting retrieval by a wealthy archer.

oo_rice_desc.value: These sticky potatoes make for excellent pancakes in the morning.

oo_barrel_desc.value: This is a barrel used to store fruity Kin pekonch, light enough to be enjoyed by anyone.

oo_barrel2_desc.value: This is a barrel used to store Teot pekonch, comparable to a hefty merlot.

oo_bees_desc.value: Wulfgang's bees are hard at work.  The small jungle bees produce honey at a remarkable pace.

oo_bigiron_desc.value: It takes years to properly season one of these pots.

oo_bigurn_desc.value: It is unclear what this urn is meant to store, perhaps it is only there for decoration.

oo_block_desc.value: Used to split wood and occasionally behead an animal.  The axe would be useless in a battle.

oo_bluejug_desc.value: This ornate earthenware is empty right now. You can only wonder as to its true purpose.

oo_tallurn_desc.value: You decide it was a bad idea to look in here.  The brown urn is half way filled with discarded fruit skins, animal bones and other rubbish.

oo_bucket_desc.value: Used for hauling water up from the well.

oo_bunny_desc.value: The haul from an early morning hunting trip.

oo_corn_desc.value: The browncorn cobs of this healthy stalk have been recently harvested.

oo_ironpot_desc.value: A small iron pot used for cooking broth and soups.  You smell the fishy aroma of a salty Mapkina stew.

oo_lantern_desc.value: The iron sides protect the candle flame within.

oo_lettuce_desc.value: A full head of Marion Cabbage grows here.

oo_pigeon_desc.value: Baked with browncorn, these birds will make an excellent evening meal.

oo_pitcher1_desc.value: Piping hot pitcher of herbal tea.  Its bitter taste must mean that it is only used for medicinal purposes.

oo_pitcher2_desc.value: Too sweet for the tastes of a mainlander like yourself.

oo_pitcher3_desc.value: This pitcher is filled with viscous yolks of the palm grouse.

oo_pitcher4_desc.value: Full to the brim with powerful wine.

oo_skull1_desc.value: It is difficult to imagine why the bone priestess would carefully stack human skulls this way.

oo_skull3_desc.value: A horror created from a dark mind.

oo_skull4_desc.value: Something is definitely not right here.

oo_skull5_desc.value: You are uncomfortable looking at this tower of human skulls.

oo_skull6_desc.value: Human skulls top this frail branch.

oo_deadtree_desc.value: This tree died unnaturally young.  This is a bad omen.

oo_altar_desc.value: A foul stench surrounds this bizarre death altar.  You feel uncomfortable standing so close it.

oo_tree3_desc.value: The motubanak tree is said to be the only place that kriipa will sleep.

oo_head2_desc.value: A freakishly large skull sits atop a wooden post.  A warning, perhaps?

oo_bones_desc.value: These are the splintered, well-gnawed remains of some unlucky, and probably unwise, explorer.  You shudder to think of the fate that must have befallen this poor soul.

oo_nestobj1_desc.value: This is a mound of rich dirt and organic loam.

oo_nestobj2_desc.value: This is a mound of rich soil, mostly fresh animal droppings.

oo_barbolt1_desc.value: This is a bolt of fine cloth.

oo_barbolt2_desc.value: This is a bolt of fine cloth.

oo_barbolt3_desc.value: This is a bolt of fine cloth.

oo_barbolt4_desc.value: This is a bolt of fine cloth.  The unusual coloration comes from dye extracted from the lisith clams found along Ko'catan's beaches.

oo_barbolt5_desc.value: These are bolts of fine cloth.

oo_Bigurn2_desc.value: This is a large empty urn.

oo_nectree1_desc.value: The wood of these trees is known as the hardest of all woods, but the knots and twisting grain make it all but impossible to craft anything useful from it.  The trees are known to thrive in nearly any setting, but grow to enormous girth when near decay and gloom.

oo_nectree2_desc.value: The black color of this oak has been used in dyes and pigments, as well as more than a few mystical potions.  A campfire of coal oak lasts for days, but it would take quite the axe to dent the bark.  Some varieties have been known to stand for centuries after they are completely dead, simply because they are too strongly rooted to topple.

oo_nectree4_desc.value: The spine vine is a parasitic plant that wraps itself around the tallest gnarlwood or oak, and uses the position to spread its tendrils across the higher branches for its nourishment.  Narthyl creatures are particularly attracted to the weblike leaves.

oo_necgrave1_desc.value: Somehow you doubt that whoever was buried here rests in peace.

oo_necgrave2_desc.value: Somehow you doubt that whoever was buried here rests in peace.

oo_necgrave3_desc.value: Somehow you doubt that whoever was buried here rests in peace.

oo_halfskull_desc.value: Crushed though this skull is, you half expect it to leap up and bite you.

oo_skull7_desc.value: The skull of some poor stupid human.

oo_skull8_desc.value: The skull of something definitely inhuman.

oo_skull9_desc.value: The skull of something definitely inhuman.

oo_skull10_desc.value: What this creature might have looked like while alive simply does not bear thinking on.

oo_dung_desc.value: A fresh steaming pile of dung.

oo_hay_desc.value: A bundle of hay, picked some time ago.  It looks like something small has been nibbling on it.

oo_goathead_desc.value: This must be the grisly remains of some bizarre mystical ritual.

oo_mortpest_desc.value: A common tool used to prepare ingredients for cooking, or for other more mystical pursuits.

oo_necbottle_desc.value: A bottle containing some strange fluid.

oo_necvase_desc.value: This vase is obviously of ancient design.  You can only vaguely guess at how old it must be.

oo_necvase2_desc.value: This vase is obviously of ancient design.  You can only vaguely guess at how old it must be.

oo_necvase3_desc.value: This vase is obviously of ancient design.  You can only vaguely guess at how old it must be.

oo_sacrificialbowl_desc.value: A bowl filled with something unidentifiable.  The contents look organic, but are probably not of this world.

oo_stonechair_desc.value: A chair carved out of stone.  It doesn't look very comfortable.

oo_necvine1_desc.value: Something about this vine looks otherworldly.  You half expect it to reach out and grab your ankle.

oo_necslime_desc.value: The origin of this deposit of slime is beyond your ken.  Sure is yucky, though.

oo_razshrub_desc.value: This is a woody plant with multiple permanent stems branching near the ground.

oo_raztree1_desc.value: These trees offer cool shade and beautiful scenery.

oo_modaltar_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
This is a replica of a strange altar which was discovered on the Lost Island of Konima.  It had apparently been built by a strange hermit bird-woman who lives in the hut where it was found.  One can only guess as to its purpose, as the bird-woman appeared to be quite mad;  though obviously of the race of bird-people who inhabit the island, she spoke a language which even our avar guide was unable to understand.

oo_modant_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
These enormous, chitinous creatures seem to be everywhere, but particularly prefer to cling to high, mountainous areas.  Fledgling adventurers should run, should they see one of these.

oo_modavar_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
This is a replica of one of the race of bird-people who inhabit the recently rediscovered Lost Island of Konima.  They appear to have a fairly sophisticated culture and language, which human inhabitants of the island have yet to decipher completely.  As with the inhabitants of the human settlement of Ko'Catan, the avar seem to be a fairly war-like race, often embroiled in skirmishes amongst tribes and with the humans on the island.  One should therefore exercise caution in any encounter with an avar, as they are truly fearsome opponents in combat.  Particularly dangerous are the rarely-seen avar shaman, whose third eye gives them strange mystical abilities.

oo_modlupog_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A race of relatively peaceful amphibious creatures rumored to dwell in the sewers beneath the major cities.

oo_modorc_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A race of evil, subhuman creatures.  They were thought to be all but exterminated in the Konima wars, but an ancient warren has recently been rediscovered, and found to be teeming with the crude vermin.

oo_modspider_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Common vermin that can be found wandering around Meridian, these are excellent opponents for fledgling adventurers to develop their fighting skills.

oo_modcentipede_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
These are relatively peaceful insects, but when provoked can be quite vicious.

oo_modfungusbeast_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Often mistaken for a cluster of mushrooms, the fungus beast is a relatively peaceful creature, though if provoked it will certainly defend its territory.

oo_modfey_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The good fairy folk of the Vale of Sorrow, the Fey Elhai are locked in a perpetual struggle with their dark brothers, the Fey Dirhai, for control of the Vale.

oo_modscimitar_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The preferred weapon of the advanced warriors of the land.

oo_modhammer_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A sturdy weapon, oft found around the hills of Jasper.

oo_modshortsword_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A suitable weapon for a starting adventurer.  Cheap, crude, but suitable for smaller beasts.

oo_modhelm_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A wizard once said, "I don't see why warriors feel the need to wear helms anyway.  It's not like they ever use what a helm protects."

oo_modplatearmor_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The solid and seamless construction of this armor makes it more than preferred against an enemy warrior.  However, sorcerers have found ways to turn the armor of their opponents to their advantage.

oo_modgauntlets_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Rumor has it that these mystical gloves allow their wearer to strike with precision.

oo_modpotion_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Mystical elixers are common in Meridian.

oo_modscroll_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Letters, scrolls and recipes are often the objects of quests!

oo_modwand_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
This powerful artifact allows the bearer to strike his foe with fire!

oo_modtoken_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A mystical item so coveted that the throne of Meridian rides upon it!

oo_modlute_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The instrument of the common bard.

oo_modprism_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A powerful device allowing multiple casters to combine their energies into more powerful spells.

oo_modinkycap_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Rich and meaty in texture, inkycap mushrooms are considered ambrosia by the populace of Meridian, and their restorative properties are widely documented.

oo_modsignetring_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Everyone seems to have one of these rings.  And everyone seems to lose them, as well.

oo_modnewsb_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The common means for a citizen to trade information with others.

oo_modshrin_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The shrines of Meridian undoubtedly have great mystical significance, but the scholars of the land have been unable to agree on what, precisely, that is.

oo_modthron_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A model of the throne that the great King Far'Nohl once sat in, before his fall from grace.

oo_modchalice_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
This ancient holy grail has long been lost, bound to the darkness by the presence of evil.

oo_modrelic_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
The purpose of this unholy artifact has been lost.

oo_modmananode_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
A mage can acquire greater power by melding with this influx of mystical energy.

oo_modgrapes_desc.value:
A plaque below the model reads:
Please do not eat the wax grapes.

oo_flaskgrn_desc.value: A flask filled with some strange green liquid.

oo_flaskw_desc.value: A flask filled with some strange purple liquid.

oo_jasperlamp_desc.value: This oil lamp is intricately crafted of wrought iron, obviously the product of many days of work.  You can almost see the sweat of its maker's labour worked into the metal, a fine sheen that catches the light.  Only in Jasper would one find such a transformation of the mundane into a work of art.

oo_RRplant2_desc.value: A small tree of the palm variety.

oo_RRtable_desc.value: This small wooden table is simple in design yet sturdily constructed.

oo_RRwashbasin_desc.value: This small basin, accompanied by a magical pitcher kept eternally full of cool, fresh water, is ideal for rejuvenating the spirits of a traveller.

oo_signpost_desc.value: Whatever was once written on this signpost has long since faded.

oo_newbsign_desc.value: There's something written on this sign, but you can't quite seem to make it out.

Gods favor those who strengthen their realm on earth by giving them places of worship.  Perhaps if you were to make a proper offering here, your god would be pleased.

%s

Shrine_not_in_range.value: You are not close enough to the shrine to commune with it.

Shrine_meld.value: You kneel down before the shrine, offering your gifts.

Shrine_satisfied.value: The shrine seems satisfied by the %s.

Shrine_Shalille_text.value: You are seized by a sense of sudden well being, as though you were being held and comforted.

Shrine_Qor_text.value: A chill runs up your spine and the shadows seem suddenly darker and more foreboding.

Shrine_Kraanan_text.value: A sudden triumphant call of victory splits the heavens.

Shrine_Faren_text.value: A massive crash of the elements reverberates through the shuddering air.

Shrine_Riija_text.value: Mischievous noises cascade down from the heavens.

Shrine_Jala_text.value: A sweet song drifts lazily through the air.

Shrine_unsatisfied.value: The shrine finds nothing to its liking.

Shrine_mana_boost.value: Your body thrills to a rush of magical energy from the shrine.

assess_desc_rsc.value: This is a crude and often inaccurate technique used to gauge how good an opponent is in the art of hand-to-hand combat.

assess_below_20.value: %s%s is a twig, waiting to be broken.

assess_20_30.value: %s%s is an infant of the battlefield.

assess_30_40.value: %s%s fights hardly better than a lowly squire.

assess_40_50.value: %s%s possesses not talent, but great potential.

assess_50_60.value: %s%s has a good sense in the ways of combat.

assess_60_70.value: %s%s is firmly competent on the battlefield.

assess_70_80.value: %s%s shows the scars of many battles.

assess_80_90.value: %s%s is certainly no one to be trifled with.

assess_90_100.value: %s%s wins many conflicts without so much as shrugging.

assess_100_150.value: %s%s possesses near super-human abilities on the battlefield.

assess_150_up.value: %s%s could crush you like a bug!

CrystalizeMana_desc_rsc.value: This song catches the mana expended in singing, crystalizing it into a physical form.  The mana crystal stores the mana for later use, in essence allowing the singer to store extra mana. assgame_blade_shivers.value: ~IThe black dagger shivers ominously in your hand.

assgame_Mail_reset.value:
It turns out that the man you knew as Roq was an imposter.  Naturally, the pretender was assassinated.  A match will start anew soon enough.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

assgame_winner.value: ### %s has won the challenge of the black blades.

assgame_prize.value: ~BFor your assassin's game victory you have been awarded %s%s.

assgame_go.value: ~IYour dagger gains an unearthly glow about it.

assgame_urge.value: ~IYou have this urge to go and visit Roq.

assgame_mail_not_enough.value:
Subject: You have been expelled.
You have been expelled from the Assassin's Circle as you seem too craven to spend time in this world to take part in the proceedings.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

assgame_mail_no_kills.value:
Subject: I expect more action soon.
Two days have passed without a kill in the Assassin's Game.  Should a third pass, I will show my contempt by ending the game without declaring a winner.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

AssGame_mail_disgrace.value:
Subject: The game is ended in disgrace.
Know the face of your own disgrace.  For lack of action, I have ended the Assassin's Game.  No one wears the mantle of Assassin Supreme.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

AssGame_mail_winner.value:
Subject: One has risen above the others.
%q has won the challenge of the dark blades.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

AssGame_not_viable.value:
Subject: Insufficient combatants.
Alas, not enough warriors have answered the call for the Challenge of the Dark Blades. Fear not - I shall send word to summon you again soon and the contest shall begin anew. Keep your blade close at hand... the fight awaits.

-- Roq, the Dark Blade

faction_visit_completed.value: You learn that your liege's errand was completed, and your attempts to assist have demonstrated your continuing devotion.

faction_visit_novice.value: I am sorry, but you are not yet experienced enough to be worthy of faction membership.  Please come back later.

factionite_visit_start.value: Welcome back to court, my follower.  If you see to it that I get my message, your service obligation will be complete for a time.

neutral_visit_start.value: Greetings.  If you wish to join my faction, you must demonstrate your devotion.

faction_too_strong.value: I am sorry, but my current followers provide all the support I need.  Perhaps if you come back later, I will have need of you.

faction_visit_wrong.value: It is well known that you are a vassal of my primary opposition.  Until you change who you follow, I will not have you doing any of my errands. %s

faction_visit_wrong_accept.value: Yet, I will accept you into my faction if you bring me a token of the Meridian Council.

faction_visit_wrong_decline.value: Currently, my followers provide all the support I need. Yet, if you return later, perhaps I will have need of you.

faction_visit_too_soon.value: You need not prove your dedication again so soon.  Let others prove themselves for a while.

LM_town_tokendeath.value: I have heard that when you carry a Token of the Meridian Council, death itself has no penalty.

LM_town_tokenmove.value: No one has ever figured out why the Meridian Council Tokens occasionally teleport away from their Councilors.

LM_town_tokenblink.value: Once, I saw a Councilor set their token down in water, and a short while later, it blinked itself back to shore!

LM_monster_has_neutral_karma.value: %s%s is an innocuous creature, doing neither great good nor great evil.

LM_monster_has_bad_karma.value: %s%s is an evil creature, not as evil as some, but certainly not neutral.

LM_monster_has_low_karma.value: %s%s is a truly despicable beast, no doubt a servant of Qor.

LM_monster_for_groups.value: Probably best to tackle with friends beside you.

LM_monster_too_easy.value: %s%s would hardly be a challenge for one such as you.  It wouldn't be worth your time to hunt such an unworthy opponent.

LM_monster_too_hard.value: %s%s is tougher than you imagine, but will surely help you hone your skills... should you survive.

LM_monster_really_hard.value: %s%s is a fearsome foe.  Attacking would be tantamount to suicide.

LM_monster_about_right.value: %s%s would be a fair fight for you.  You might even pick up a new trick or two.

LM_haz_factions.value: The Duke and the Princess are always squabbling over who is the rightful something-or-other.  Fortunately, we're far divorced from that here.

LM_haz_towns.value: The five towns are far away from here.

LM_haz_help.value: I'll be what help I can be, but you should really read the signs.

LM_haz_quest.value: Ummm, I wouldn't know anything about that.  You should really ask the elder about such things.

LM_haz_quest_elder.value: Yes, yes!  I need adventurers to clear out the mausoleum on the north side of town!

LM_haz_mausoleum.value: Formerly a deeply sacred place for the townsfolk, it has since been defiled by the footsteps of the dead!

LM_haz_mummy.value: Noble ancestors or restless wanderers?  Either way, the mummies are abominations and must be destroyed!

LM_haz_quest_entroot.value: Hmmm... I've heard that Eric is always looking for entroot berries.  Don't know why, though.

LM_haz_entroot_none.value: Entroot berries?  I didn't think they grew around these parts.

LM_Haz_entroot_response.value: The mummies use the magic of the entroot to keep the magic that animates them sustained.  Perhaps one of them carries entroot.

LM_haz_smith_buy.value: If you happen to come across a stray weapon or armor, I could probably scrounge enough to take it off your hands.

LM_haz_smith_sell.value: I've got a few weapons behind the counter I can show you.  Type BUY.

LM_haz_elder_greeting.value: Ah, greetings, adventurer!  May your journey be filled with fortune and glory.

LM_haz_elder_buy.value: I have no need of worldly goods.

LM_haz_elder_sell.value: Do I look like a common peddler?  Nay!

LM_haz_apoth_buy.value: I'm running low on just about everything.  Should you find reagents, I'll happily take them off your hands.

LM_haz_apoth_sell.value: My cupboards are nearly bare.  All I have at this time are red mushrooms.

LM_haz_innk_buy.value: I'm not in the market for anything that comes to mind.

LM_haz_innk_sell.value: I have no vacant rooms to rent.

LM_haz_bar_buy.value: I think my dealer would get mad if I was caught trading with ye!

LM_haz_bar_sell.value: I've got ample foodstuffs to keep an adventurer hale and hearty!

LM_haz_meridian.value: That's where we are, of course!  Naturally, this is merely the outskirts.  You want to enter the heart of things, if you're a true adventurer!

LM_haz_ravi.value: The apothecary is always looking for reagents to keep his stock from running dry.

LM_haz_rodric.value: I've heard that the old man has a quest for you.

LM_haz_marcus.value: A good man!  A good man!  His inns are an excellent place to recuperate, should you find yourself wounded.

LM_haz_tomas.value: An armed warrior is always better than a naked one.  Spend what you have on weaponry at Tomas' shop - you'll earn more.

LM_haz_eric.value: The finest barman this side of Barloque!  I've heard he seeks something...

LM_no_mana_nodes.value: You have not yet bonded with any mana nodes.

LM_mana_nodes.value: Your aura is connected with these mana nodes: %q.

QM_missed_middle.value: What's that?  That doesn't make any sense to me.  Are you sure you went to see %s%s and get the ~Iactual~n message for me?

QM_never_sent.value: Perhaps you are trying to deceive me?  I don't believe you ever asked to do a favor for me.

QM_no_record.value: Hmmm.  Are you sure you were asked to fetch this message?  Maybe you should go back and make sure.

QM_old_phrase.value: Many thanks, but I was already given that message by another.

QM_mob_phrase.value: I heard %s%s had a message for me.  I'll reward the first person who brings it to me.

QM_mob_object.value: Sorry, I don't need anything now.  However, you know that I am prepared to reward you well when the time is right.

QM_hint_msg.value: Who sent you? I'll see if I have a message for them.

QM_mob_int_phrase.value: Go and bring me a message from %s%s, or if you aren't up to it now, please send someone else here to assist me.

QM_hint_int_phrase.value: On a mission from the royal court I see.  Please tell %s%s, ~B%s %s %s~n.

QM_hint_phrase.value: I'd be grateful if you told %s%s, ~B%s %s %s~n.

QM_already_done.value: You have already earned my favor; you don't need to keep trying.  When you are ready, I shall gladly teach you.

QM_ID_congrats.value: Your favor is duly noted.  When you are ready, return to me and I shall gladly teach you.

QM_item_congrats.value: I am indebted to you.  Please allow me to give you something in return.

QM_money_congrats.value: Thank you.  I can only reward your hard work with money, but surely you can use it for something you've been wanting.

QM_item_too_heavy.value: Since you can't carry anything, I'll just set %s%s at your feet.

QM_join_congrats.value: Thank you for signing on.  I expect great things from you.  Please accept a small monetary gift to help you in your travels.

QM_visit_congrats.value: Your dedication is again shown, and here are some coins for your troubles.  You need not return to court for quite some time.  But, if you can ever return a token of the Meridian Council to its rightful owner, perhaps he will smile upon our causes.

LM_shal_prst_faction_resign.value: You can resign from a faction by bringing me a Council Token as proof of your desire, or just wait for your liege to grow dissatisfied with your devotion and strike you from their rosters.

LM_onecon_banker_buy.value: I know secrets, yes, but I'll only share them with a master of the arts.

FC_2.value: Thy soul is in the thoughts of Shal'ille.

FC_3.value: You'd bow before Kraanan the Fist.

FC_4.value: The tumult of Faren's energy is not to be scorned.

FC_5.value: Deceiving Riija is a goal unto itself.

FC_10.value: You have a great longing to see the Temple of Kraanan.

FC_11.value: Long wished-for powers will soon be within your reach.

FC_12.value: Your faction is gaining in power.

FC_13.value: Some people are born great; others make themselves great; and still others have greatness thrust upon them.  Which one are you?

FC_14.value: Discretion is the better part of valor.

FC_15.value: Never look a gift-orc in the mouth.

FC_16.value: Beware servants of Qor bearing gifts.

FC_17.value: Stand by your friends in battle and reap great rewards.

FC_18.value: A student of Faren will bring you good news.

FC_19.value: Red-stained skies mean chaos on the rise.

FC_20.value: Stop searching forever; happiness is right next to you.

FC_21.value: What is this life, coursing in our veins like fire?  Life is like hot iron, ready to pour; choose the mold, and life will burn it.

FC_22.value: Take care of your sword and your sword will take care of you.

FC_23.value: Great wealth is within your grasp if you seize the opportunity.

FC_24.value: Kraanan helps those who help themselves.

FC_25.value: A fool and his shillings are soon parted.

FC_26.value: Many people stumble upon the truth from time to time, but most pick themselves up and go on as if nothing had happened.

FC_27.value: Someone is waiting for you in Ukgoth.

FC_28.value: Luck will be with you in your next tournament battle.

FC_29.value: You will play an instrumental role in your guild today.

FC_30.value: Glory will be yours in the arena.

FC_32.value: Most evil people are simply misunderstood, don't you think?

FC_33.value: Life is fleeting, but a good name endures forever.

FC_34.value: You were meant for great things.

FC_35.value: Trustworthy friends are an adventurer's greatest asset.

FC_36.value: Meidei has a special errand for you.

FC_37.value: Consult with a friend before undertaking your plan.

FC_39.value: The time to act is now.

FC_41.value: Don't believe everything you read in these cookies.

FC_110.value: The number fourteen will serve invaluable today.

FC_111.value: Your love will be more important than your wisdom today.

FC_112.value: You will play a key role in some intrigue soon.

FC_113.value: Familiarity breeds contempt. But without familiarity, you can't breed much of anything.

FC_114.value: Your health is fleeting. If your feet are not also, your health will outrun you.

FC_115.value: Pay close attention to your vigor today; it will be important.

FC_116.value: Not every mushroom has value. Not every person you call 'friend,' either.

FC_117.value: You shall fall into something profitable before the moon and sun align.

FC_118.value: A newsball is a wicked way to spread a rumor.

FC_119.value: Wait not for friends to save your own skin; but be ready to save theirs.

FC_120.value: Seeking the power you know you already possess is foolhardy. Use it.

FC_121.value: Forge an alliance before it is too late.

FC_122.value: Pay attention to those who gather yet do not speak openly.

FC_123.value: There are three who will conspire against you today.

FC_124.value: A great weight shall soon be lifted from your shoulders.

FC_125.value: You must be prudent in your expenditures, both financial and physical.

FC_126.value: You must act now to avert imminent disaster.

FC_127.value: An ancient place with a forgotten name shall be your bane.

FC_128.value: You will play a key part in the discussions of the council.

FC_129.value: You will have an effect on Shal'ille's influence over the woodlands.

FC_130.value: Kraanan's Fist is as hard as stone. Your resolve to succeed nearly matches.

FC_131.value: The Princess's followers are gaining in power. It is up to you.

FC_132.value: The Duke's henchmen grows in power. You hold the key to his destiny.

FC_133.value: The sky shall rain with the blood of chaos.

FC_135.value: You may once be as renowned as Konima.

FC_136.value: Jasper's legends mean much to your destiny.

FC_137.value: You will meet with Cylill in the near future.

FC_139.value: Your goals are within reach. Move quickly.

FC_140.value: You have few enemies, but justice shall be done.

FC_141.value: A friend in Barloque has a story to tell.

FC_142.value: Before you rest today, you will find good fortune.

FC_143.value: The stars shall conjunct with an evil omen for Meridian.

FC_144.value: Your own friends shall challenge your strength soon.

FC_145.value: Immortals are just Immortals, but Greenwich is more like a meal.

FC_146.value: Immortals will not die by any natural means, but that shouldn't stop you.

FC_147.value: The ends of the world are not absolute limits.

FC_148.value: The first to discover new lands is not always the first to profit.

FC_149.value: Find the source of the orcs: you shall be key in their demise.

FC_150.value: The lore of Riija is lost forever, some say. That should not stop you.

FC_151.value: Seek the red Jewel of Froz, for its magic is the crux of the most powerful spells.

FC_153.value: You will find a new companion in Jasper.

FC_154.value: An evil force will enter the world.

FC_155.value: A dark deed is in store for the Royal Court.

FC_156.value: A tragedy will befall you near water.

FC_157.value: You will find great fortune in a dark place.

FC_158.value: Gold will now come your way.

FC_159.value: You never hesitate to fight dangerous opponents.

FC_160.value: A good time to finish up old quests.

FC_161.value: You are generous in matters of food.

FC_162.value: The spirit of King Zarcos II watches over you.

FC_163.value: A good time to be guild master.

FC_164.value: Guildhalls are meant to be conquered. Take arms.

FC_165.value: The University returns to power.  Learn all you can.

FC_166.value: Recognition for your deeds will come soon.

FC_167.value: Rethink your problem, a new solution is needed.

FC_168.value: A good game of chess is in order.

FC_169.value: A visit to the old castle could prove fruitful, if you survive.

FC_170.value: The gods will smile down upon you and your guild.

FC_173.value: This cookie will have a key role in your vigor today!

FC_174.value: When Faren smiles, heat is cast.

FC_176.value: When you see the underworld...  It will probably not be empty!

FC_177.value: If you love them, set them free.

FC_178.value: Ye shall cast out the evils of the land with the might of the Fist.

FC_179.value: Your skill shall uphold the law against the lawless who prey upon the innocent.

FC_180.value: Qor may master evil, but you will master good.

FC_181.value: What you are seeking, might be right under your nose.

FC_182.value: Kraanan the Mighty will shield you from vicious attacks of Qor today.

FC_183.value: Those who study magic must be wary that magic does not begin to study them.

FC_184.value: The very strong become weak, as the world watches in amusement.

FC_185.value: The true path to enlightenment comes from within.

FC_187.value: Afiera D'xor say man with knight shield soon to crunch gravel in underworld.

FC_188.value: You should cut down on fortune cookies!

FC_189.value: Always remember to never look up in a rainstorm. You don't know who really is mad anyway.

FC_190.value: Always show respect to your elders; they hit pretty hard.

FC_191.value: Always remember to never look a gift horse in the mouth, they bite.

FC_192.value: In the end, the blade if given the time will strike down the most practiced magician.

FC_193.value: Heed who thou wouldst let enter thy guild, for the temptation of a hall and its treasures is the prize all seek.

FC_194.value: If you aim to be a hunter of man, then you must learn to hone your skills in the solitude to desolate lands.

FC_195.value: The princess is good and just but her teachings will bring a warrior no victories in the field of combat.

FC_196.value: You have more friends than you know, and more enemies than you can imagine.

FC_197.value: The gentle healing touch of a stranger shall save your soul from the raging hellfire of the underworld.

FC_198.value: You will soon feel the icy touch of death, and the warmth of the hellfire in the underworld.

FC_199.value: The Vale of Sorrow takes many men to get the node and back again.

FC_201.value: Help! I am being held captive in a Meridian fortune cookie factory!

FC_202.value: Forgive your enemies, but never forget their names.

FC_203.value: It does not matter if you win or lose, it's if you survive.

FC_204.value: Don't forget Shal'ille's umbrella at the great ocean.

FC_205.value: The force of Shal'ille's light will be with you today.

FC_206.value: Your determination will bring you much success.

FC_207.value: The secret to good friends is no secret to you.

FC_208.value: You have the rare ability to decide quickly and wisely.

FC_209.value: Bide your time, for success is near.

FC_210.value: He who expects no gratitude shall never be disappointed.

FC_211.value: You are capable of greater things than you realize.

FC_213.value: Be on the alert for new opportunities.

FC_214.value: All will go well with your new quest.

FC_215.value: Your happiness is intertwined with your outlook on life.

FC_216.value: You have the rare ability to recognize ability in others.

FC_217.value: The moon is in proper phase for casting illusions.

FC_218.value: You will soon journey to a distant island.

FC_219.value: You will play a crucial role in the next Justicar election.

FC_220.value: Bring lots of money to the gaming table, you will need it.

FC_221.value: You will soon win the favor of a Bard.

FC_222.value: Be kind to the guides and they will be kind in turn.

FC_223.value: He who meets new friends shall never find boredom.

FC_226.value: Even things thought to be dead can be brought back to only near death.

FC_228.value: Beware the fearsome, mana stealing Xeochicatl this day.

FC_229.value: Show respect to those that form the world, and you will see respect in return.

FC_230.value: If someone takes the time to listen to you it does not mean they are deaf.

FC_231.value: Have you told that certain someone how you really feel?

FC_232.value: Your happiness is influenced by both the friends and the enemies you make in your life.

FC_233.value: Beware the next ring you pick up.  It may not be what you expect.

FC_234.value: Serenity can only be achieved by doing what makes you happy.

FC_235.value: Learn from the children.  It is important to set aside time for play as well as for work.

LM_haz_rand1.value: If you've never been to Meridian before, you might find it helpful to read the signs.

LM_haz_rand2.value: In Meridian proper, there are more than one hundred and fifty spells in six spell schools!  But the magical arts are largely lost here.

LM_haz_rand3.value: The crypt is full of mummies!  How so holy a place became so defiled is a question for the ages.

LM_haz_rand5.value: What you see is but a fragment of Meridian 59.  Perhaps you'd care to see the rest of the land?

LM_haz_rand6.value: I've heard that the struggle between the Princess and the Duke continues.  I have also heard of another rebellion starting in Jasper.  Fortunately, we are largely unaffected here on the frontier.

LM_haz_rand7.value: For all that I can tell you, the best advice I can offer is to seek friends and allies.

LM_haz_rand8.value: Some adventurers are bloodthirsty killers!  Fortunately, the magiks of Shal'ille protect our fair town from such unsavoriness.

LM_haz_rand9.value: Sometimes I wish I were adventuring out in the heartland!  But my place is here.

LM_haz_rand10.value: Shal'ille loves the young and foolish.  Your guardian angel will protect you for quite some time.

LM_haz_rand12.value: Rumour has it that Barloque has become a nest of assassins!  Fortunately, we are far divorced from that here.

LM_haz_rand13.value: In faraway Tos, there is supposedly a great arena where mighty warriors prove who is the greatest champion!

LM_haz_rand14.value: Even now, the fey elhai and the fey dirhai wage war for the Vale of Sorrows.

LM_haz_rand15.value: A mighty warrior can spurn magic by advancing his skills.  Unfortunately, there are no notable teachers here.

LM_haz_rand16.value: Should you kill something, be sure to get the stuff that's been dropped.  Often, you can sell it for a few shillings.

LM_haz_rand17.value: Be sure that you use your map to help you navigate around.  Type MAP to see it.

LM_haz_rand_apoth1.value: Ravi, the alchemist, is always looking for herbs and mushrooms.  Should you find some, he'll offer a good price.

LM_haz_rand_bar1.value: If you're weary or wounded, Eric's Tavern is a good place to stop and rest.

LM_haz_rand_inn1.value: Be sure to read all of the signs.  If you've wandered off the path, the sign at the inn on the north side of town is the first.

LM_haz_rand_elder1.value: Eventually, be sure to seek out the elder.  He has been seeking warriors to help fend off the mummies!

LM_haz_rand_smith1.value: The blacksmith in the northwest part of town has excellent weapons for training adventurers.

lib_signet_lost.value: You pat your pockets and check your pack, but you suddenly realize the signet ring you were carrying is gone!

ReInitialize
messages.doc: This routine strips the library and yet keeps the quester and hinterlists. This means that you dont have to recreate the mobs to fix anynasty bugs that happened. It also finds any mobs who are condsellersand resets them so their triggers stay in the mob lib. It also putsthe quests of permquesters back into the scheme of things. It doeskeep the old phrase and class lists so that possibly there will besome continuity kept for the players who are just a bit slow.

messages.name: Recreate
messages.doc: Basically this does everything to recreate the library except clearthe plQuestUser list that keeps track of which players have donewhich permaquests. If the permaquest id's change, this will be messedup then...

messages.name: Delete
messages.doc: Dereferences the three main library lists (yeah garbage collection)Since the moblib should be used mainly for random quests, this willcause some mucky problems, unless we clear the quests as well.Basically, you shouldn't be deleting this object.

CreateRandomLibrary
messages.doc: Basically, any library entry desired is just added in at an appropriate place. The library is a list of two-element nodes. Each node is a classname and a list of entries. Each entry consists of three elements: Percentage, Restriction Vector, List of the Action type and its parameters. The percentage is from 0 to 100, and for the action to be triggered, the incoming percentage must be greater or equal to the library percentage (so 0 is never, 100 is always, etc)

NodeAttack_failure_rsc.value: ~BThe node at %s has been drained by the attacking Xeochicatl!

NodeAttack_loss_mail_rsc.value:
Subject: The loss of the node
It is with a heavy heart I report that the Xeochicatl have attacked and drained the node at %s.  Our forces were not able to repel the attacks and the node was lost to us.  As a result, you will not be able to draw mana from this node for a while.

I hope in the future we will know how to better repel these attacks.  We must be ever vigilant against these attacks.

NodeAttack_severed_mail_rsc.value:
Subject: The severing of your node
It is with a heavy heart I report that the Xeochicatl have attacked and drained the node at %s.  Unfortunately, the violent draining of the node severed your connection with it.  Our forces were not able to repel the attacks and the node was lost to us.  As a result, you must meld with the node again when it becomes available in the future.

I hope in the future we will know how to better repel these attacks.  We must be ever vigilant against these attacks.

default_message.value: Red Sky begins before the next full moon.

default_assign_hint.value: You have been assigned a new questnode.

temp_assign_hint_bring_me_item.value: Excuse me.  I was just doing some minor experimentation with the fringes of the known magics.  I need %INDEF_CARGO %CARGO to continue my research.  Could you be so kind as to bring that to me?

temp_assign_hint_bring_message.value: Please deliver this message for me to %NPC: %CARGO

temp_success_hint_bring_message.value: Thanks, but I already knew that.

temp_assign_hint_reward_message.value: You can tell %NPC this for me, though: %CARGO

temp_success_hint_reward_message.value: For stating the obvious, your reward is %INDEF_PRIZE %PRIZE.

default_success_hint.value: You have successfully completed this questnode.

first_success_hint.value: Ah, just the person I was looking for.

temp_success_hint_bring_me_item.value: Thanks for bringing me %DEF_CARGO %CARGO.  I don't have much, but let me give you %INDEF_PRIZE %PRIZE for your trouble.

default_failure_hint.value: You have failed to accomplish my request in a timely fashion.  I am very disappointed in you.

never_again_failure_hint.value: Hmmph.  You have failed me.  I will not impose on you in the future with requests of this sort.

temp_assign_hint_chess1.value: I'm playing a chess game with %NPC.  I've been thinking about it, and I'm ready to send %HIMHER_NPC my next move.  Would you please tell %HIMHER_NPC that my move is %CARGO?

temp_success_hint_chess1.value: A brilliant move, but easily blocked.

temp_success_hint_chess2.value: That peacock told you that, eh?

temp_assign_hint_chess3.value: Well, tell %HIMHER_NPC %CARGO.  And while you're there, tell %HIMHER_NPC 'checkmate'.

temp_success_hint_chess3.value: A cunning move.  I must be sure to congratulate %NPC.  Take this %PRIZE as a token of my appreciation for being our courier.

temp_assign_hint_monster.value: Beware %DEF_MONSTER %MONSTER, my beamish boy.  The jaws that bite, the claws that catch.  Willst thou slay him for me?

temp_success_hint_monster.value: Oh, calloo, callay, frabjous day!  Thoust hast slain %DEF_MONSTER %MONSTER.

temp_assign_hint_monster_item.value: I need you to go forth and kill %INDEF_MONSTER %MONSTER, and bring me %DEF_CARGO %CARGO fresh from his steaming carcass.  I will reward you suitably.

temp_success_hint_monster_item.value: Ah, that's just what I needed.  Here is your compensation, %INDEF_PRIZE %PRIZE.

temp_assign_hint_food_item.value: I'm a little hungry, and I've been having a craving for %INDEF_CARGO %CARGO.  Would you be so kind as to bring one to me, right away?

temp_success_hint_food_item.value: Oh, yummy!  Thank you, and here's %INDEF_PRIZE %PRIZE.

temp_assign_hint_E3_message.value: Can you help me?  I am in terrible trouble.  When I was outside the walls picking mushrooms, a vicious band of Avar attacked me.  Although I escaped, I dropped Tepal's Book of Scavengermancy.  He will hate me if I don't get it back for him.  Could you go find it and bring it to him?  Please.  If you do I'll cast a hex to make you stronger for a few days.

temp_success_hint_E3_message.value: There's my book!  Well, orc-be-damned, I thought it was gone forever.

temp_failure_hint_E3_message.value: Didn't Zala mention something to you about getting back my book?  Well, you can forget about that.  I don't want it anymore.  And I'll tell you something, it will be a long time before I lend her anything again.

duke_join2_assign.value: So, you wish to prove yourself worthy of my trust?  You can begin by bringing me %INDEF_CARGO%CARGO.

duke_join2_success.value: Ah, good work.  Your service to our cause will not go unnoticed.

duke_join2_failure.value:
Subject: You may not join our ranks, knave!
Hah!  You are not faithful enough to serve our cause!

duke_standard2_assign.value: Ah, %NAME, my loyal servant.  I require you to collect all taxes due from %NPC.  Return within the hour.

duke_standard2_failure.value:
Subject: Tax Collection
I could not wait any longer, I have already sent another courier to collect my taxes.

duke_standard3_assign.value: Oh, yes, my tax money for the Duke...  Here it is, %INDEF_CARGO%CARGO.

duke_standard3_failure.value:
Subject: Your membership in my faction has been revoked
You have failed me.  I will not be so foolish as to rely on your service in the future.

princess_join2_assign.value: So, you wish to prove yourself worthy of my trust?  Wouldst thou be so kind as to deliver an official letter to %NPC?  I would be most grateful.

princess_standard2_assign.value: Ah, %NAME, my loyal servant.  Wouldst thou be so kind as to deliver an official letter to %NPC?  I would be most grateful.

princess_standard2_success.value: A letter from her highness?!  Excellent.  Thank you, %NAME.

princess_standard2_failure.value:
Subject: Your membership in my faction has been revoked
Thou hath failed me.  I will not be so foolish as to rely on thy service in the future.

rebel_join2_assign.value: You wish to join our fight for freedom?  I cannot trust you, for you may be a spy for my enemies.  Prove your value by bringing me %INDEF_CARGO%CARGO.

rebel_join2_success.value: Excellent work!  This will equip the troops I field in battle.  Consider yourself one of the freedom fighters for the land.

rebel_join2_failure.value:
Subject: Your lack of action.
Your lack of actions probably confirms my fears that you were a spy for the other weak leaders.  Do not bother me again with your false desires to fight for true freedom.

rebel_standard2_assign.value: Ah, %NAME, my fellow freedom fighter.  My troops have need of more equipment.  This war costs us much, and I do not have the luxury of a large treasury like the other leaders do.  Bring me %INDEF_CARGO%CARGO and I will not forget your loyalty.

rebel_standard2_success.value: Ah, excellent.  I will definitely put this to good use.

rebel_standard2_failure.value:
Subject: You are not a true rebel
You have failed me when I needed you most.  Go crawling to one of the other lieges, for I have no more use of one such as you.

disciple_learn_success.value: ~ISo, you wish to become my disciple?~I

disciple_assign.value: ~IYou must prove yourself before your learning may progress.  Bring me %CARGO.~I

disciple_success.value: ~IYou have proven yourself, my disciple.  Your learning may now progress.~I
